title: Smoked Cod Pasta Bake
description: A comforting Irish-inspired pasta bake featuring smoky cod and a nourishing blend of vegetables.
instructions: Cook the gluten-free pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish.
Top the pasta with smoked cod and shredded cheddar cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
